v1.0.1-preview.13
- Added offline-first mutation persistence: SqliteLocalStore now implements ILocalStoreMutationQueue and ILocalStoreOverlayCache via SqliteLocalStore.Mutations.cs partial, storing mutation_batches, document_overlays, and mutation_queues tables in the same SQLite database. Enables offline writes to survive app restart.
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.13, which adds offline-first optimistic writes and eliminates the proto-to-JSON round-trip.

v1.0.1-preview.12
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.12, which fixes ObjectDisposedException on SemaphoreSlim.Release() during network disable and UnobservedTaskException from WebChannel receive-loop exceptions during concurrent disposal.

v1.0.1-preview.11
- Synchronized package version with the preview.11 release.

v1.0.1-preview.10
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.10, which fixes the "Cursor has too many values" error on snapshot-cursor pagination queries.

v1.0.1-preview.9
- Synchronized package version with the preview.9 release.

v1.0.1-preview.8
- Added SQLITE_FULL (disk-full) handling: RunAsync detects Result.Full, maps to FirestoreErrorCode.LocalCacheFull; write methods catch, evict via CollectGarbageAsync, retry once, surface SqliteFirestoreException(LocalCacheFull) if eviction cannot recover.
- Added RunInTransactionSafe wrapper that preserves the original SQLITE_FULL exception through rollback failures (sqlite-net RunInTransaction masks the original exception with the rollback exception).
- Replaced all db.RunInTransaction calls with RunInTransactionSafe in DeleteDocumentAsync, RemoveIndexAsync, and EvictOldestNonPending to prevent rollback-masking of SQLITE_FULL.
- Split SqliteLocalStore into partial classes by interface concern (Documents, Indexes, Cache) for SRP and maintainability.
- SqliteFirestoreException now extends FirebaseCoreException<FirestoreErrorCode> directly.

v1.0.0-preview7

- Mandatory final LocalQueryEvaluator execution for Firestore semantic correctness.
